ev.q: DOHMH conducted telephone interviews with the 44 patients with confirmed S-OIV on April 27.
The most frequently reported symptoms were cough (in 43 patients [98%])
37 (88%) of 42 specimens collected in the emergency department and local physicians' offices tested positive
Onset of illness for 28 cases was April 23
Among 35 patients who reported a maximum temperature, the mean was 102.2°F (39.0°C)
In total, 42 (95%) patients reported subjective fever plus cough and/or sore throat
This report describes the initial outbreak investigation by the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH)
